reviews.title: Good value, decent quality
reviews.comment:
Pros: 
- Great value, the cheapest mid-tower I could find
- Roomy
- Good cable management features
- Sturdy, seems solidly built 

Cons:
- Front vents are tiny
- Front cover is hard to take off (you basically have to rip it off)
- A USB-C front port would be nice

The ugly:
- The manual is hot garbage

reviews.title: A great pure performance build for non-rgb lovers
reviews.comment:
This was a good purchase hower theres just a few things you should know.

You might have to bend the metal where the gpu goes because you won’t be able to plug in the HDMI/DP

Also the sides are a pain to take off and put back on so just keep that in mind

However its great for a non RGB pure performance build, you can fit a 4090 and 280Rad with a top of the line atx mobo.
